an8.119:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya aṭṭha dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an8.119:1.3: ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni.
an8.119:1.4: tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmīti evaṃ saññī hoti.
an8.119:1.5: ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmīti evaṃ saññī hoti.
an8.119:1.6: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmīti evaṃ saññī hoti.
an8.119:1.7: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmīti evaṃ saññī hoti.
an8.119:1.8: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni, nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni,
an8.119:1.12: atāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmīti evaṃ saññī hoti.
an8.119:1.13: rāgassa bhikkhave bhiññāya ime aṭṭhadhammā bhāvetabbā.
